_comment: Tracked (committed) attempts manifest for batch SRGRB_20260727. Small, human/machine-readable JSON only -- not raw evidence. Contains Trial 1 Attempt 1 only -- no future RUN_ID values are invented in advance. classification=PENDING is a PLANNING STATE ONLY, not a result -- hil_repeatability_batch_aggregator.py's VALID_CLASSIFICATIONS is exactly VALID/INVALID/EXCLUDED, so a manifest containing any PENDING entry cannot be fed to the aggregator at all. No trial result -- valid, invalid, or excluded -- is implied by PENDING. This file will be updated (in a further commit) with the real classification and reason once Trial 1 Attempt 1's post_run_verification.json actually exists after shutdown. verification_json_path is relative to this manifest's own directory, resolved by hil_repeatability_batch_aggregator.py against the manifest file's location, never the process's current working directory.
